# ui::Subscription

Header: `winui/core/Property.hpp`.

One edge of the observer graph: keeps a handler registered on a [Property](property.md) or [Signal](signal.md) for as long as it lives, owned by the observer.

Move-only. Destroying, [reset()](#reset)ting or move-assigning over it unsubscribes; if the observed [Property](property.md) dies first the subscription goes dead ([alive()](#alive) turns false), so either end may be destroyed first. Not a template, so an [Element](../tree/element.md) holds bindings of any value type in one std::vector<Subscription>.

Example: 
```cpp
ui::Property<int> count{0};
auto label = std::make_unique<ui::TextControl>("0");
ui::TextControl* observer = label.get();

// Owned by the label: unsubscribes when the label is destroyed.
label->add_subscription(count.observe([observer](const int& n) {
    observer->set_text(std::to_string(n));
}));

// Or held by hand for a scoped observation.
ui::Subscription sub = count.observe([](const int& n) { std::printf("%d\n", n); });
count = 1;   // both handlers fire
sub.reset(); // only the label's remains
```

## Subscription

```cpp
Subscription() = default
```

A dead subscription observing nothing; [alive()](#alive) is false.

## ~Subscription

```cpp
~Subscription()
```

Unsubscribes (see [reset()](#reset)).

## Subscription

```cpp
Subscription(const Subscription&) = delete
```

Not copyable: one subscription is one edge.

## operator=

```cpp
Subscription& operator=(const Subscription&) = delete
```

Not copyable: one subscription is one edge.

## Subscription

```cpp
Subscription(Subscription&& other) noexcept
```

Takes over `other`'s place in the observer list; `other` is left dead.

## operator=

```cpp
Subscription& operator=(Subscription&& other) noexcept
```

Unsubscribes this one, then takes over `other`'s place; `other` is left dead.

## reset

```cpp
void reset() noexcept
```

Unsubscribe now. Idempotent, and safe after the observed [Property](property.md) has been destroyed.

## alive

```cpp
bool alive() const noexcept
```

False once this subscription has been [reset()](#reset), moved from, or had its [Property](property.md) destroyed out from under it.
